root_cause.text: The RZN1 DMAMUX route-allocation error path in `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate()` failed to release the reference-counted DMA master OF node (`dma_spec->np`) on late allocation failures, causing an OF node reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the `-EBUSY` failure branch from `goto free_map;` to `goto put_dma_spec_np;` and adds `of_node_put(dma_spec->np);` before freeing the map, while the CVE/commit message explicitly states “fix OF node leak on route allocation failure” and “drop the reference taken to the DMA master OF node also on late route allocation failures.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the busy-channel error path to use the correct cleanup label and release resources properly.
intent_record.what: The error-handling branch after test_and_set_bit(map->req_idx, dmamux->used_chans) was changed to jump to put_dma_spec_np instead of free_map when the requested channel is already busy and ret is set to -EBUSY.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when allocation detects that the DMA channel is already in use, cleanup now follows a different error path that preserves the correct resource-release order, likely ensuring the dma_spec node reference is released before any map cleanup and avoiding incorrect or incomplete cleanup on this failure path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Release the `dma_spec->np` OF node in the DMA mux allocation error path to fix a reference leak.
intent_record.what: A new error-handling label `put_dma_spec_np:` was inserted between `clear_bitmap:` and `free_map:`, and it calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` before proceeding to free the map and continue existing cleanup.
intent_record.how: On error paths that jump through this cleanup sequence, the device tree node referenced by `dma_spec->np` is now properly released, preventing a leaked OF node reference during failed DMA route allocation.

grouping_result.intent: Release the `dma_spec->np` OF node in the DMA mux allocation error path to fix a reference leak.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix DMA mux allocation and busy-channel error paths so resources and OF node references are released correctly on failure.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly fixes the DMAMUX allocation and busy-channel failure paths to properly clean up resources, including explicitly releasing the reference-counted OF node dma_spec->np on allocation failure, which matches the stated root cause.

candidates.rationale: On the busy-channel failure path, this jump bypasses the cleanup path that should release additional resources, contributing to leaked references/resources on allocation failure.
This shows the pre-fix error path stopped after freeing the map and did not release the reference-counted dma_spec->np OF node, matching the root cause of a late-failure OF node reference leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This busy-channel failure jump routes execution to a cleanup path that frees the map but skips releasing the reference-counted DMA master OF node dma_spec->np on late allocation failure, causing the OF node reference leak described in the root cause.

This pre-fix cleanup statement shows the error path ended after freeing the map, without also dropping the dma_spec->np OF node reference. That incomplete cleanup is the direct cause of the leaked OF node reference on late allocation failures.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable logic is fully visible in `rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate()`. The function acquires a reference-counted OF node with `dma_spec->np = of_parse_phandle(ofdma->of_node, "dma-masters", dmac_idx);`. After that, there are late failure paths: `if (test_and_set_bit(map->req_idx, dmamux->used_chans)) { ret = -EBUSY; goto free_map; }` and `ret = r9a06g032_sysctrl_set_dmamux(mask, val ? mask : 0); if (ret) goto clear_bitmap;`. Both paths eventually reach `free_map:` which only does `kfree(map);` and returns `ERR_PTR(ret)`. There is no `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` on these error exits after `of_parse_phandle()` succeeded, so the OF node reference is leaked on late allocation failures. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present, and the fix is not present.
